lines.t: Verse 1
I looked up and lost the edge of it
Sky bleeding out into endlessness
Light from a million dying suns
Still reaching here where I’m standing
Every star like a signal fire
Burning out in the silent choir
And I’m just dust with a beating heart
Caught in the pull of Your orbit
Pre-Chorus
How do You see me here
In the middle of all of this?
Chorus
You’re writing light into my darkness
Calling life out of empty space
With a voice that outlasts forever
Still You’re whispering my name
I don’t have to reach the edges
I don’t have to understand
If the hands that hold the cosmos
Are the same that hold my hand
Verse 2
Space keeps stretching, it won’t stay still
Edges running past what we can feel
Black holes bending the light itself
Still You’re closer than breath is
Quasars scream in the far unknown
Echoes of power we’ve never known
But louder still is the quiet grace
Calling me out of the shadows
Pre-Chorus
How do You know my name
With everything spinning like this?
Chorus
You’re writing light into my darkness
Calling life out of empty space
With a voice that outlasts forever
Still You’re whispering my name
I don’t have to reach the edges
I don’t have to understand
If the hands that hold the cosmos
Are the same that hold my hand
Bridge (ambient / build)
Atoms, oceans, light in motion
All of it held in Your hands
Time collapsing, gravity bending
Still You choose to understand
You saw me before I was breathing
Counted the hairs on my head
The same voice that scattered the starlight
Is calling me back from the edge
Breakdown
Beyond comprehension
Still You come close
Final Chorus
You’re writing light into my darkness
Calling life out of empty space
With a love that outlasts forever
Still You’re calling me by name
I don’t have to reach the edges
I don’t have to understand
If the hands that hold the cosmos
Are the same that hold my hand
Are the same that hold my hand
Outro
I looked up… and You were there
In every light-year, every breath
The edge of space, the edge of me
And somehow… You’re closer still
